Bug_Title: MS: May expose internal representation by returning a buffer sharing non-public data (MS_EXPOSE_BUF)
Bug_Details:
A public static method either returns a buffer (java.nio.*Buffer) which wraps an array that is part of the
static state of the class by holding a reference only to this same array or it returns a shallow-copy of a buffer
that is part of the static stat of the class which shares its reference with the original buffer.
 Any code that calls this method can freely modify the underlying array.
 One fix is to return a read-only buffer or a new buffer with a copy of the array.
Bug_Explanation: A public static method 'getBuffer' is returning a ByteBuffer which wraps an internal static byte array'sharedBuffer'. Any code that calls this method can modify the underlying array'sharedBuffer'.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method calls the showBug method of the BufferBug class, which modifies the first byte of the shared buffer. The test then checks the first byte of the buffer returned by the getBuffer method. If the bug in the getBuffer method is not properly addressed, the test will fail because the shared buffer and the buffer returned by getBuffer will refer to the same underlying array, and the first byte of the buffer returned by getBuffer will be modified.
